card.line: Hazor was a strong Canaanite city in northern Canaan, ruled by kings named Jabin, and it was conquered by Joshua, then later fell to Assyria.

moments.title: Joshua burns Hazor
moments.text: Jabin king of Hazor gathered northern kings to fight Israel. After the LORD gave Israel victory, Joshua captured Hazor, killed its king, and burned the city, the only one of those cities he burned.

moments.title: Jabin oppresses Israel
moments.text: After Israel again did evil, the LORD sold them into the hand of Jabin, who reigned in Hazor. His commander was Sisera, and Jabin harshly oppressed Israel for twenty years.

moments.title: Assyria captures Hazor
moments.text: In the days of Pekah king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser king of Assyria captured Hazor and other places, and he took the people as captives to Assyria.

moments.title: A warning about Hazor
moments.text: The LORD spoke through Jeremiah about the kingdoms of Hazor, which Nebuchadnezzar had defeated. He said Hazor would become a haunt for jackals, a desolation forever.
